entries.title: Source reference clarified: GSFC00.1_MSS
entries.text: The methods section identifies the Goddard Spaceflight Center mean sea surface as the reference for these SSH anomaly maps. The original area transcriptions remain unchanged; their earlier reference-unspecified note is superseded by this review. Scalar uncertainty remains unspecified.

entries.title: Duration unresolved: table and final-date figure disagree
entries.text: Table 3.1-2 reports 216 days from the split and 328 days including the parent interval. Figure 3.1-22 labels the last tracked date November 6, 2005. From the reported split on December 13, 2004, that date gives 328 elapsed days; from parent separation on August 23, 2004 it gives 440. No preferred lifespan or uncertainty range is assigned; the duration-reference gap remains open.
